title: Valve's City 17 uprising (d3_c17_01 to 13)
about: Valve's own City 17 uprising maps (d3_c17_01 onwards; the Source SDK copies the owner uploaded, 21 November), measured from the VMFs by map_ingest.py (each map's numbers in valve_d3_c17_NN/measure.json) and drawn by map_view.py (flat colours; props as boxes of their true size, orange static, yellow physics, cyan dynamic, green NPCs; a prop whose size is unknown is a small marker) or as true slices across a street (dark grey solid, white air, pale blue sky, a grid every 128 across and 64 up). Reference only, for shape and dressing: the VMFs are not in the repo, and the owner's own choices win where they differ (streets, stairs, rooms).
numbers: d3_c17_01: Kleiner's lab after the teleport, the rebels' hidden lab; all indoors: rooms 348 by 971 (medians) under 306 (most often 320 and 352), corridors 189 wide under 120, one door01_left in an opening 48 by 108.

d3_c17_01: the most crowded place measured so far: 1.31 props per 100 by 100 of play (the streets of d3_c17_02 to 05: 0.15 to 0.58), 71% of statics touching a wall; lab lights (lab_flourescentlight001a and b, 14), pipes, power boxes, crates and file cabinets.

Ours: rooms 120 to 128 high in City 18's two tones with a dado rail. Valve's lab is a hall about 306 high, its walls banded (brickwall052e below brickwall052d, the first change 64 or 128 over the foot): a lab or workshop hideout can stand taller than a flat.

Ours: streets keep a crown, a kerb of 8 and pavements of 96. d3_c17_10b Combine architecture: the Combine's part is brushwork, not props: metalcombine001 on 4639 faces (the most used material, area 668 x 10000 against the old plaster's 762), 921 brushes, most of them thin plates (2 thick 356 times, 8 thick 167, 1 thick 104; longest side median 64); 14% of their faces off the right angles (the old building's plaster 4%), leaning 45 to 70 degrees from flat and turned 25, 45 or 65 degrees in plan; it fills the middle of the block (x 3072 to 4352, y -1024 to 0, 128 to 768 up) and an upper floor (x 2560 to 3584, y -2304 to -1536, 512 to 944 up).

Ours: rooms 120 to 128 high in City 18's two tones with a dado rail. Valve's Nexus keeps the old building's rooms (192 high, plaster banded over tile) and sets the Combine's metal inside them as a second skin of thin, tilted plates, so the Combine reads as grown in, not built from scratch.

d3_c17_11: out of the Nexus over its roof and down into the streets (the frame of d3_c17_10a); half the nodes outdoors, most of them on roofs: ceilings indoors 176 (35 of 120) and 128 (20); corridors 128 wide; no kerbed street cut at all (walls median 96 tall: parapets); fronts 64% of wall area (building_template017b, 029j, 029i).

Ours: streets keep a crown, a kerb of 8 and pavements of 96. Valve's d3_c17_12 park streets are flat with kerbs of 4 and the craters cut straight through road and pavement.

d3_c17_10a and 12, the Nexus from outside: an old civic block (about x -444 to 1700, y 4500 to 7900) facing the park; a portico 256 proud in the middle of its park front (columns, steps up 8 by 12 from the plaza), storeys in building_template029 (g, f, d, b, then a cornice of 029j stepping out 32 at 800), a metal mansard roof (metalroof008a) to 960 and a lower middle wing at 896. The Combine's mark outside is props: CombineInnerwall plates (001a 306 by 296 by 999, 001c 90 by 253 by 805, some leaning 5 degrees) set into the front from the ground to 1025, two more standing on the roof to 1441 and 1601; inside it is brushwork (d3_c17_10b).

styleguide_c17_rubble: Valve's style room for City 17 in ruins (a sample, not a level): 30 props in play and no lamps lit (sun '213 152 85 500' at pitch -25, ambient '154 123 61', fog '181 146 121' from 100 to 5000: a warm dusty haze); the ruin is made of big models (collapsedbuilding01awall 4, collapsedbuilding02c 2, building_brokenexterior002a, b and c 6, concrete_debris256pile001a 2, parliament_dome_destroyed_exterior, project_destroyedbuildings01) on displacement ground (21 displacements, still in dev_blendmeasure on 414 faces); lampposts 801 apart along the road, a car, a tanker and a truck cab left on it.

styleguide_c17_rubble skeleton: a block stripped to floors every 128 (0 to 512) on posts 32 by 32 and 512 tall (8), with a broken-exterior model (40 by 257 by 128, one storey tall) hung on each open floor edge; d3_c17_12b uses the same models on floors 192 apart.

styleguide_c17_rubble_2: a ruined street corner (813 Hammer-hidden objects left out, among them 295 path nodes): 219 props in play, 46 physics (33% of them lying: boards, crates, chairs); wires on utility poles (utilitypole02b 11, 856 apart): 17 spans, median 816 long, slack 100, width 2; fronts 39% of wall area (courtyard_template003f, building_template017o, storefront_template001g); walls banded in 52% of tall columns, the first change 128 or 256 over the foot; 48 displacements; sun '219 191 148' at pitch -25, fog from 100 to 8000.

styleguide_c17_rubble_2 ruined shop: a corner shop open to the street (display_cooler01a 4, kitchen_fridge001a 3, propane canisters 3, chairs knocked over) under broken floors: concrete_section64floor001b and 001c pieces (24) along each break, rebar (rebar001c_64 6, rebar003c_64 4) out of them, walldestroyed09c (4) and debris piles (128 and 256 across) under the holes; bottles and cans (garbage_glassbottle 12, popcan01a 5) scattered as physics props.

pictures.where: d3_c17_10b, the middle of the Nexus from the south-west, box x 2900 to 4500, y -1200 to 200, cut at 420, the CombineInnerwall and combine_bridge props left out
pictures.teaches: The Combine grown into an old block: plaster rooms 192 high on the ground floor (floor 256) with the Combine's metal (metalcombine001, blue-grey) set inside them as a second skin of thin plates, cold blue light, consoles (combine_interface with a monitor on it) and generators in rows on the walls; the old outer walls stay.

pictures.where: d3_c17_10b, eye level in a Combine corridor in the middle of the Nexus looking east (eye 3500 -456 320, yaw 0)
pictures.teaches: A Combine corridor 192 high: on one side the metal panels stand 48 to 72 from the middle of the walk, stepping in and out by 8 to 24 every 32 to 64; the other side opens into bays 88 to 408 deep; no two panels the same, nothing on a centre line. This is the Combine's odd, unsymmetrical look: plates of 1 to 8 thick, many tilted, rather than a plain metal box.

pictures.where: d3_c17_10b, eye level in the Nexus courtyard looking north-east (eye 2432 -608 320, yaw 45)
pictures.teaches: The courtyard inside the Nexus, open to the sky, floor at 256: old stone walls (stonewall050c) 352 to 608 away, steps up (8 by 12) to the next level, a force field (comshieldwall2, the cyan sheet) 420 east closing the way, Combine metal round the doors and a combine_generator01 by them.

pictures.where: d3_c17_11, a street closed by the Combine from the south-west, box x 300 to 1500, y 3300 to 4600, cut at 420, the CombineInnerwall props left out
pictures.teaches: A street 576 wide shut from wall to wall by nine combine_barricade_med01a (96 by 65 by 108) 64 apart in one straight row, no gap; the fronts either side keep their shop storeys. A Combine closure, not a checkpoint: nobody passes.

pictures.where: d3_c17_11, the roofs of the Nexus from the south-west, box x 600 to 2200, y 4800 to 7700, the CombineInnerwall and combine_bridge props left out
pictures.teaches: The Nexus roof at 960 as a Combine post: parapets round flat roofs, a health and a suit charger side by side, crates stacked three, substation transformers (orange boxes) and vent ducts on the roof, soldiers (green) at the edges; the combine_bridge walkways between roofs are left out (they draw as boxes 320 by 212 by 429).

pictures.where: d3_c17_12, eye level at the park's west side looking east after the battle (eye -2336 7072 194, yaw 0)
pictures.teaches: The park of U24 after the battle: shell craters (brown) about 250 across and up to 190 deep cut through the paving, rebel barricades (barricade_short04a, orange) across the ways, some in pairs splayed like a V, a colonnaded front at the end. The same place, two states: a map piece can swap its whole, clean dress for a broken one.

pictures.where: d3_c17_10a, the Overwatch Nexus from the south-west, box x -900 to 2500, y 4200 to 8200 (the CombineInnerwall plates drawn as orange boxes of their size)
pictures.teaches: The Nexus is an old civic block the Combine took, not a new building: a portico 256 proud in the middle of its park front, storeys in building_template029 to a cornice at 800, a metal mansard roof to 960, a rounded corner; the Combine's plates (the orange boxes, 306 by 296 by 999) stand in the front and over the roof to 1601, off the axis and not in pairs. For Living City: a Combine building can be one of the city's old fronts with a few Combine plates breaking through it, never symmetrical.

pictures.where: d3_c17_12b, the ruined block from the south-west, box x -5899 to -4099, y -720 to 1080 (the busiest knot of props, 50 near -4998 179)
pictures.teaches: A block with its front blown off: floors 192 apart left open to the street like a doll's house, broken-edge models (building_brokenexterior002c, 40 by 257 by 128) along each open floor, concrete_section pieces and rebar at the breaks, rubble and barricades (orange) inside where the rebels hold it.

pictures.where: styleguide_c17_rubble, the ruined block from the south-west, box x -3981 to -2181, y 988 to 2788
pictures.teaches: A block stripped to its frame: floor slabs every 128 (0 to 512) on posts 32 by 32 and 512 tall, and on each open floor edge one broken-exterior model (building_brokenexterior002a, b or c, 257 wide and 128 tall, one storey). A ruin is a kit: slabs, posts and edge models, not hand-cut broken brushes.

pictures.where: styleguide_c17_rubble_2, the ruined corner shop from the south-west, box x 315 to 2115, y 1078 to 2878 (the busiest knot of props, 57 near 1214 1977)
pictures.teaches: A corner shop under broken floors, still stocked: coolers, fridges and propane along the walls, chairs knocked over; concrete_section64floor pieces (24) along each break with rebar out of them, walldestroyed09c and debris piles of 128 and 256 under the holes, bottles and cans thrown about. A looted shop for a rebel or scavenger scene.

pictures.where: styleguide_c17_rubble_2, eye level in the street looking north (eye 2636 -1422 2108, yaw 90; the room has no visible nodes, so the eyes were placed on floors round the props)
pictures.teaches: A ruined street that still has its wires: utility poles (utilitypole02b) 856 apart carrying spans median 816 long with a slack of 100, a debris pile (concrete_debris256pile001a, the orange box at the front) and a wrecked hatchback on the road, rubble ground of concretefloor020a and 007a.
